1.e4 e6 2.b4 Bxb4 3.e5.strategy: Gains space and keeps the g8 knight from its natural square, since a knight on f6 would be captured. But Black is a pawn up, the bishop on b4 is not attacked, and the pawn on e5 itself has no defender, so White has given a pawn for little more than space.
1.e4 e6 2.b4 Bxb4 3.e5.name: French Defence: Banzai-Leong Gambit, Pinova Gambit
